items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But one important appearance was with Oscar Peterson. Of course, with Louie Bellson, Joe Pass, and me, and Oscar, of course. Oscar [with accent]. [laughs] And Ray Brown, I think. Yeah.

ctx.x: …but it’s more of a cops and robbers movie rather than a cowboy movie. But kind of same spirit. So, let’s see, one of the things that I want to talk about is, as we were getting into your career after the ’60s into the ’70s, was talking about some of the pairings that you had with various other artists. In Montreux, you did a lot of pairings with like Oscar Peterson.
And then you did, you were with Diz in 1980, and he had Bernard Purdie and those kinds of things.
